what: NopSCADlib OpenSCAD 'vitamins' dimension tuples: extrusions.scad (MakerBeam, E1515..E4080 T-slot profiles), extrusion_brackets.scad (inner corner, corner, 3D cube brackets), ball_bearings.scad (608, 62x, 6200, MR/F series), linear_bearings.scad (LM3UU..LM16UU + long/open), rails.scad (MGN5..15, HGH15/20, SSR15 + carriages), belts.scad (GT2/GT3/T2.5/T5 by width), pulleys.scad (GT2 16T/20T/80T pulleys + idlers), nuts.scad (hex nuts, sliding T-nuts M3..M8, hammer nuts M3/M4, DIN 562 thin square nuts), leadnuts.scad (LSN8x2, LSN8x8, SFU1610 lead nuts; the TR8 screw dims are taken from these). Stored verbatim; never executed. Read by catalog_import.py with a regex over the `NAME = [ ... ];` tuple lines. NOTE: NopSCADlib has no rods.scad / leadscrews.scad tuple list (rod.scad is a parametric module with no table), so the 'rod' and 'leadscrew-tr8' families are hand-entered in catalog_import.py citing the catalogue plan and the lead-nut tuples.
